raw.buffDescription: Defender begins the fight with a number of Skirmish charges based on the Attacker's Challenge Rating. When the Defender is struck, blocks an attack or lands an attack 1 Charge is lost. When the charges run out, the Defender will fight more erratically, and gain [16982bff]+100%[-] Attack and Ability Accuracy.
